Line 219 replaces the whole Guards intro line with a placeholder. Line 235 drops every line that holds the bullet marker or the sentence start. Rationale: FR-1 and FR-2 state where the new sentence and the new bullet go, and FR-5 allows one clause on line 68. The README at 5442514 is correct by diff, so the README holds no wrong text.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md line 29 gives the diff stat of the range 6cbbe7b..HEAD as 4 files, 321 insertions, and 5 deletions. The same command at the audited HEAD 5442514 prints 5 files, 329 insertions, and 8 deletions. Rationale: the numbers are true for the pushed head f5d2806 only.
